details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The gold target is 2, while the predicted answer gives 97.9%, which does not match the requested percentage.
details.groundedness_reasoning: The sources give 97.9% covered by at least 2G and 96% covered by 3G or above in 2024. Subtracting the latter from the former gives 1.9%, which rounds to the gold target of 2% for people covered by 2G but not a more advanced network.
